name: openbb_economy_calendar
description:
Economic events calendar (releases with actual, consensus and previous values) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.calendar), in OpenBB's default date window.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (accepted by the schema, ignored by this command); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp, fred, nasdaq or tradingeconomics; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Another source: fmp_economic_calendar; company earnings dates: openbb_equity_calendar_earnings. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "nasdaq"}
